title: Resolution urging Albany to fund youth justice programs
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature to pass and the Governor to sign S.643/A.8491, creating a $50 million Youth Justice Innovation Fund. The fund would support community-based organizations providing violence prevention, alternatives to detention, and education and job training for youth and young adults up to age 25. Supporters say it would help New York City sustain services under the Raise the Age law, which the state does not currently reimburse.
